Subject: Gainsight renewal quote + proposed SOW for Redwood Inference

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is the formal renewal quote and the proposed SOW for our support services covering the upcoming 12-month term. High level: 10% list discount applied for seats + an optional premium 24/7 on-call add-on (line-item). We've also included 40 hours of migration/enablement support in the SOW.

Quick notes:
- Term: 12 months starting 2027-01-01.
- Qty: 250 CS seats + 5 admin licenses.
- Add-on: 24/7 on-call response with 1-hour P1 SLA (optional).
- Data: standard HVAs for logs retained for 13 months (we call out exportability).

Attachments: [Attachment: Gainsight_Renewal_Quote_Q4.pdf (PDF, 245 KB)], [Attachment: Gainsight_SOW_SupportServices_v1.docx (DOCX, 78 KB)]

If you can confirm the list of required entitlements (admin scopes, integrations with Intercom and Zendesk), I will scope any necessary connector dev time and include the final numbers. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Renewals Lead, Gainsight
elena.rossi@gainsight.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@gainsight.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gainsight renewal quote + proposed SOW for Redwood Inference

Thanks Elena — quick read-through and a few items we need clarified before we route to procurement/legal: 

1) Discount/term: The 10% discount is appreciated. Can you quote the 24/7 on-call as an explicit line item with the impact to ARR if we add it? Also provide pricing for a 24-month term (we may prefer extended term if unit economics look better).

2) Migration hours: Confirm that the 40 hours are dedicated to our Intercom -> Gainsight sync, and whether those hours include custom mapping (we typically need 8-12 mapping hours for our event taxonomy). If additional hours are needed, include rate cards.

3) SLA/data handling: We need the P1 on-call SLA language in the SOW and a statement about data retention/export. Our security team requires explicit contract language that Redwood owns exported analytic/event logs and that logs can be delivered on request within 72 hours.

4) Legal redlines: Copying Markus for standard data handling and indemnity clauses. Please include your standard DPA link or sample language.

5) Timing: We are targeting sign-off by week of 2026-12-13 to align with budget cycle. Can you provide an updated quote by EOD 2026-12-04?

Sending to Monica and Markus for visibility on the SOW and commercial terms — Monica, happy to sync on acceptance criteria for the migration engagement.

Thanks,
Mina
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
(Attachment referenced: original quote and SOW)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@gainsight.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@gainsight.com>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gainsight renewal quote + proposed SOW for Redwood Inference

Mina — thanks for the clear asks. See updated details below and attached updated docs:

- Term pricing: Attached is both 12-month and 24-month pricing. 24-month gives an additional 6% effective discount (total 15% vs list) when paid in annual installments.
- 24/7 on-call: Now an explicit add-on line item in the quote. Price shown for 12-month and 24-month variants.
- Migration hours: Confirmed — 40 hours cover connector setup, mapping workshop, and QA for Intercom -> Gainsight. We call out a separate rate card for any additional custom mapping beyond the initial 40 hours (hourly rate $220/hr).
- SLA/data handling: We added a paragraph in the SOW that the customer (Redwood Inference) retains ownership of exported analytic/event logs. For delivery within 72 hours, we will include an export-run fee in the SOW but guarantee turnaround SLA. We also attached our DPA draft.
- Legal redlines: Attached a v2 of the quote and SOW with comments.

Attachments: [Attachment: Gainsight_Renewal_Quote_Q4_v2.pdf (PDF, 248 KB)], [Attachment: Gainsight_SOW_with_redlines.docx (DOCX, 92 KB)], [Attachment: Gainsight_DPA.pdf (PDF, 55 KB)]

DocuSign: We can issue a DocuSign envelope once commercial terms are confirmed — I can drop that in within the same day.

If you confirm the 24-month uplift window by EOD Monday (2026-12-07), I can lock the extended-term pricing.

Best,
Elena
Renewals Lead, Gainsight

Forwarding updated quote and SOW from Gainsight. Highlights for procurement/legal review:

- Commercial: 12-month vs 24-month options in the attached quote (see Gainsight_Renewal_Quote_Q4_v2.pdf). 24-month yields ~15% off list and would smooth spend into 2027–2028. Deal id RWI-PS-2026-GSN-0921.
- Technical: 40 hours migration included for the Intercom integration; additional hours at $220/hr. Monica, please confirm the mapping expectations (8–12 hours is our baseline).
- Legal/security: Gainsight attached a DPA and included language about ownership of exported logs and a paid export SLA (72 hours). Markus, please advise if the export fee is acceptable or if we need it removed.
- Timing: Need sign-off by week of 2026-12-13 to align with budget cutover.

Attachments: Gainsight_Renewal_Quote_Q4_v2.pdf; Gainsight_SOW_with_redlines.docx; Gainsight_DPA.pdf

Next steps I propose: Procurement to confirm preferred term (12 vs 24) and confirm budget line, Legal to review DPA + export fee, and CS to confirm migration acceptance criteria. If procurement approves 24-month, I will request Elena to send a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Thanks,
Mina
